name: 33974 · Lehigh Acres, FL
findings: ZIP 33974 (Lehigh Acres) has 8 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (75%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33974 (Lehigh Acres) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
